name: Never*Mythical*Utopia -wonder forest-
source:
You play as the protagonist, and the goal is to achieve an ending with one of three male characters. The ending you get depends on the final affection level. Affection changes based on your choices, and if it reaches a certain value, you can finally see the perfect Love Ending♪.

Just spending time with your chosen character will easily get you to the ending, so nothing difficult here.

The protagonist and the three guys spend seven days together after getting lost in the forest. They gather food, sometimes take breaks, and enjoy their time. There are a total of four endings available.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20030805220607/http://ririn.vivian.jp/game/nmu-about.htm]the official website[/url]]
translation:
你扮演主角，目标是与三个男性角色之一达成结局。你得到的结局取决于最终的好感度。好感度会根据你的选择而变化，达到一定值后，你终于可以看到完美的爱情结局♪。

只要花时间和你选择的角色在一起就可以很容易地到达结局，所以这里没什么困难。

主角和三个家伙在森林里迷路后一起度过了七天。他们收集食物，有时休息一下，享受时光。共有四种结局可供选择。

[翻译自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20030805220607/http://ririn.vivian.jp/game/nmu-about.htm]官网[/url]]
